animations.name: Light Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Animate a clean, crisp crouching light jab spread smoothly across the clip, pure body motion only in completely empty air around the fighter: staying firmly anchored in the exact same low kneeling crouch on the ground baseline without standing up, he first coils slightly back in brief anticipation; then he rotates his shoulder forward and shoots his front arm straight out horizontally to the right into a full, crisp crouching jab (fist closed, arm parallel to the ground, rear fist tucked tightly in guard near his chin); after a brief clear extension at full reach, he smoothly retracts his punching arm back into the exact starting low crouching guard pose. Preserve Oscar's face, black outfit, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
